changes: Documented that Gulf Coast and Great Plains NAAMP programmes targeted surveys within three days of rainfall under the national protocol.
Explicitly characterized DaysSinceRain as an observational exposure partly conditioned by programme scheduling in some regions.
Added Royle and Link (2005) to distinguish behaviour-sensitive calling observations from latent abundance.

Strengthened literature-based activation-threshold interpretation using species-specific weather responses, rainfall/flood-dependent breeding strategies, threshold/lag differences and inundation responses.
Added reviewer-response language that protocol conditioning prevents causal interpretation and is not removed by matching or geographic robustness.
unchanged: no authorized species-level rainfall-response trait mechanism
